sources.title: Xizhou Town in Dali: Things to Do & How to Get to - ChinaXianTour
sources.content:
Xizhou Town in Dali - Complete Content Extract

Overview
Xizhou Town is described as "the Famous 'Museum of Bai Residence Architecture'" - a thousand-year-old village in Dali, Yunnan known for well-preserved traditional Bai minority architecture blending Bai and Han Chinese styles.

Fast Facts
- Chinese name: 喜洲镇
- Location: North of Xiaguan Town, west of Erhai Lake, in Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture
- Area: 81 km2
- Time needed: Approximately 3 hours
- Distance: 18 kilometers from Dali City; 19 km from Dali Old Town
- Access: Public bus, car, taxi, or bicycle

Historical Background
The town has "a rich history which can back over a thousand years" serving as an important cultural and commercial center for the Bai people. It flourished under the Dali Kingdom and survived the Ming and Qing dynasties.

Architectural Highlights
- Over 150 well-preserved Ming-Republic era Bai family compounds
- 88 Bai residential buildings total
- Signature layouts: "three houses and one screen wall" and "four houses and five courtyards"
- Design features: Carved beams, overlapping arches, flying eaves, decorative illumination walls

Top Things to Do & See

Admire Ancient Architecture: The architecture reflects "unique architectural aesthetics and wisdom of the Bai people."

Experience Local Markets: Sifang Street is "the social and market hub of Xizhou" serving mainly locals with fresh produce, dairy, and Bai snacks.

Bai Three-Course Tea Ceremony: A hospitality ritual featuring three teas:
1. "Clear and bitter tea" - thicker, bitter tea leaves roasted over gentle fire
2. "Sweet tea" - adds brown sugar, milk fan, walnuts, sesame
3. "Aftertaste tea" - mixed with honey and 4-6 peppercorns

Tie-Dye Workshops: Xizhou is "a center of Bai tie-dye" with over 1,000 years of history. Workshops last about 1 hour, costing 30-80 RMB.

Food & Dining
- Xizhou Baba: "Crispy outside, soft inside" flatbread with savory or sweet fillings
- Milk Fan (Rushan): Fermented dairy, grilled or fried
- Bai-style Dumplings: Lightly seasoned with meat, vegetables, or herbs
- Yunnan Rice Noodles
- Lemongrass Grilled Fish

Best Time to Visit: March to May and September to November when weather is mild, approximately 20 degrees.

Transportation
- By Bus: Most economic, about 30 minutes from Dali City Bus Station
- By Train: Dali Railway Station is about 18 km from Xizhou
- Minibus: 5-8 yuan, 40 minutes from Dali Ancient City

Accommodation: Traditional Bai courtyard homes recommended for authentic cultural experience.

sources.title: Xizhou Ancient Town: Xizhou Village in Dali, Yunnan (With Map) - Asia Odyssey Travel
sources.content:
Xizhou Ancient Town in Dali, Yunnan

Xizhou Village, with a history of more than 1000 years, is located 18 km north of Dali Old Town, west leaning on Cangshan Mountain with Erhai Lake to the east. Known as the "Museum of Bai Residence Architecture" due to its well-preserved traditional architecture of the Bai minority.

The largest scale of Bai Residence Architectures are well-preserved here, featuring the classic "three houses and one screen wall" and "four houses and five courtyards" layout.

The Three Way Tea Ceremony is a hospitality ritual of the Bai people featuring three courses of differently prepared tea.

Xizhou Baba is a local snack with a crispy crust and soft inside, available in both sweet and salty flavors.

sources.title: Xizhou Ancient Town - Holy Land of the Bai Nationality - Visit Yunnan China
sources.content:
Xizhou Ancient Town - Holy Land of the Bai Nationality

Xizhou Ancient Town is located 18 km north of Dali Ancient City, between Cangshan Mountain to the west and Erhai Lake to the east. It has been an important cultural and commercial center for the Bai people for over a thousand years.

The town preserves over 150 Bai-style courtyard homes from the Ming, Qing, and Republican periods. The architecture combines Bai and Han Chinese building traditions with distinctive features like carved beams, painted walls, and elaborate screen walls.

Key attractions include Sifang Street (the central market), the Yan Family Mansion, the Dong Family Mansion, and numerous traditional craft workshops specializing in tie-dye, embroidery, and silverwork.

The town is known for its authentic Bai cultural experiences including the Three-Course Tea Ceremony, traditional markets, and local cuisine featuring Xizhou Baba flatbread and milk fan.

sources.title: Xizhou Ancient Town - Yunnan Exploration
sources.content:
Xizhou Ancient Town, Dali

Xizhou is one of the most well-preserved ancient towns in the Dali area, known for its traditional Bai architecture and living cultural traditions. Located 18km north of Dali Old Town, between Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake.

The town served as a major commercial hub during the Ming and Qing dynasties, and many wealthy merchant families built elaborate courtyard homes that survive today.

Visitors can explore traditional markets, try local Bai cuisine, participate in tie-dye workshops, and visit historic family compounds. The town offers a more authentic experience than busier tourist destinations in the area.

sources.title: Xizhou Ancient Town - IslamiChina Travel
sources.content:
Xizhou Ancient Town, Dali

Xizhou Ancient Town is a well-preserved Bai ethnic town located about 18 km north of Dali Ancient City. The town has a history of over 1,000 years and is known as the "Museum of Bai Residence Architecture."

The town features over 100 traditional Bai courtyard homes from various periods, with the Yan Family Compound and Dong Family Compound being the most famous.

Key experiences include:
- Viewing traditional Bai architecture with "three courtyards and one screen wall" layout
- Tasting Xizhou Baba (local flatbread)
- Watching tie-dye demonstrations
- Visiting morning markets
- Experiencing the Three-Course Tea Ceremony

Getting there: Take a minibus from Dali Old Town (about 30 minutes, 5-8 yuan).

sources.title: 喜洲古镇 - 百度百科
sources.content:
喜洲古镇 - 百度百科文本内容

基本信息
喜洲古镇位于大理古城以北18公里处，"东临洱海，西枕苍山，是白族聚居的城镇，保存最多、最好的白族民居建筑群"。

建筑特色
古镇展现了典型的白族建筑风格，包括"三坊一照壁"及"四合五天井"的庭院格局。"民居雕梁画栋、斗拱重叠、翘角飞檐、门楼、照壁、山墙的彩画装饰艺术绚丽多姿"。现存110余院白族特色传统建筑。

主要景点

大青树：村头两棵古老的大青树，被称为"风水树"，是白族村庄兴旺的象征。传说一棵萌发时另一棵落叶。

四方街："镇中心——四方街，是由店铺围成的小广场"，竖立有"文明坊"石坊。

重点院落：严家大院、董家大院等。

历史背景
喜洲曾为"河蛮"聚居地，古称大厘城。"早在南诏迁移过来洱海周围之前，这里就是白族先民的聚居地"。隋代被称为史城。"历史上喜洲镇是南诏的军事重镇"。

现代发展
- 2017年入选省级特色小镇创建名单
- 2019年获评"云南省特色小镇"
- 2020年创建为省级旅游度假区和旅游名镇
- 2020年接待游客约200万人次
- 扎染产业链年产值超7000万元
- 打造生态农产品品牌如"喜米""喜油"

sources.title: 大理喜洲攻略丨放空时间，稻田边上的咖啡与日落 - 知乎
sources.content:
大理喜洲攻略

喜洲古镇位于大理古城沿214国道或大丽线往北约22公里处。以四方街为中心，共有明代、清代、民国以及当代各个时期各具特色的上百院白族民居建筑。

门票信息：喜洲镇免费，镇上内部景点收费。

交通：在大理古城有直达喜洲古镇的班车，10分钟左右一趟，车程约半小时；也可自驾，注意不能直接开车进古镇。

特色体验：扎染是当地的一大文化特色，也是大理民间传统的非遗项目，可以亲自上手体验。

美食推荐：喜洲最为出名的是喜洲粑粑，四方街的喜洲粑粑最正宗，10块一个。

喜洲的稻田边有多家咖啡馆，可以一边喝咖啡一边欣赏稻田和苍山的美景，尤其是日落时分特别美丽。
